description: Measure technical debt and cognitive load in any JS/TS or Python git repo with a pinned tool set (ESLint 9 + sonarjs cognitive complexity, complexipy, jscpd, git history) running inside a bubblewrap sandbox with no network and the repo mounted read-only. Reports cognitive complexity per function, duplication, oversized files, change amplification and churn x complexity hotspots, per repo plus a cross-repo summary. Use when asked to "analyse tech debt", "measure cognitive load", "find hotspots", "debt analysis", "how hard is this code to understand", "compare repos for debt", "review AI-generated code for complexity", or invokes /pinned-debt.
